neighbours.label: the token ' one' (or ' per') as a quantity word before a noun (on one page, in one place, per day)
fire: Please keep all the receipts together in one folder.
We managed to see every museum in one afternoon.
The tickets cost twelve dollars per adult.
All of the tools fit neatly on one shelf.
The recipe makes enough for four people in one batch.
The car uses about six litres of fuel per hundred kilometres.
She packed everything she owned into one suitcase.
There is only room for two guests per cabin.
quiet: Please keep all the receipts together in a folder.
We managed to see every museum in a single afternoon.
The tickets cost twelve dollars for each adult.
All of the tools fit neatly on the shelf.
The recipe makes enough for four people in a batch.
The car uses about six litres of fuel every hundred kilometres.
She packed everything she owned into a suitcase.
There is only room for two guests in each cabin.

notes: Early layer, broad. Card: ' one' x17, ' per' x6. Probe: 'on one page' 0.62, 'in one person' 0.53, 'per person' 0.54; 'a single page' 0.16. Pole is broad (2.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) so near misses may fire weakly.
